title.zh: 新泽西州请求最高法院裁定预测市场体育博彩由谁监管
title.en: New Jersey asks Supreme Court to decide who regulates sports betting on prediction markets

current_state.zh: 新泽西州已请求美国最高法院裁定预测市场上的体育博彩应由州还是联邦监管；NFL提交法庭之友意见书支持最高法院受理该案，并主张Kalshi体育合约为赌博。
current_state.en: New Jersey has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to decide whether sports betting on prediction markets should be regulated by states or federal authorities; the NFL filed an amicus brief supporting Supreme Court review and arguing Kalshi's sports contracts are gambling.

updates.title_zh: 新泽西州请求最高法院裁定预测市场体育博彩由谁监管
updates.title_en: New Jersey asks Supreme Court to decide who regulates sports betting on prediction markets
updates.what_changed_zh: 新泽西州已请求美国最高法院裁定预测市场上的体育博彩应由各州还是联邦当局监管。
updates.what_changed_en: New Jersey has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to decide whether sports betting on prediction markets should be regulated by states or federal authorities.
updates.current_state_zh: 新泽西州已请求美国最高法院裁定预测市场上的体育博彩应由各州还是联邦当局监管。
updates.current_state_en: New Jersey has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to decide whether sports betting on prediction markets should be regulated by states or federal authorities.

updates.title_zh: NFL 向最高法院表示预测市场体育合约属于赌博而非互换
updates.title_en: NFL tells Supreme Court prediction market sports contracts are gambling, not swaps
updates.what_changed_zh: NFL提交法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理新泽西州的挑战，并主张Kalshi的体育合约属于赌博而非受CFTC监管的掉期。
updates.what_changed_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the U.S. Supreme Court to take up New Jersey's challenge and arguing that Kalshi's sports contracts are gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps.
updates.current_state_zh: 新泽西州已请求美国最高法院裁定预测市场上的体育博彩应由州还是联邦监管；NFL提交法庭之友意见书支持最高法院受理该案，并主张Kalshi体育合约为赌博。
updates.current_state_en: New Jersey has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to decide whether sports betting on prediction markets should be regulated by states or federal authorities; the NFL filed an amicus brief supporting Supreme Court review and arguing Kalshi's sports contracts are gambling.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to take up New Jersey's challenge and rule that Kalshi's sports contracts constitute gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to take up New Jersey's challenge and rule that Kalshi's sports contracts constitute gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps.
